channel.title: Farmer's Weekly SA - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farmer's Weekly SA (farmersweekly.co.za)

item.title: Join us at the 2026 Malanseuns Garden Festival!
item.description: Get ready to dig in, explore, and be inspired! The third annual Malanseuns Garden Festival, taking place from 10 to 12 April, promises a vibrant weekend filled with lush displays, hands-on learning, and outdoor fun for all ages.

item.title: Gauteng scales up FMD vaccination as cases climb to 228
item.description: Gauteng’s battle against foot-and-mouth disease has entered what provincial authorities describe as its ‘most decisive phase’, with a scaled-up vaccination programme launched on 26 February as the number of confirmed cases continues to rise.

item.title: Budget 2026: agriculture gets support, but biosecurity gaps remain
item.description: The response to the 2026 Budget Speech, delivered in Parliament on Wednesday by Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana, was largely positive. However, the absence of specific support to address the foot-and-mouth disease outbreak has left the sector feeling discouraged.

item.title: Stronger exchange rate could cut macadamia income by 15% this year
item.description: While the long-term outlook for South Africa’s macadamia industry remains bullish, the ongoing import tariff uncertainty in the US and a stronger exchange rate are set to leave farmers with slim margins this year.

item.title: SA can help Kenya with maize, but GMO rule stands in the way
item.description: South Africa is well positioned to supply maize to drought-stricken Kenya in the current marketing year, but policy constraints around genetically modified (GM) grain remain a key obstacle to meaningful trade flows.

item.title: JMC Vigus Pro ready to stir the entry-level bakkie pot
item.description: After a 10-year hiatus, Chinese manufacturer Jiangling Motors Corporation (JMC) has returned to South Africa with the budget beater Vigus Pro bakkie, writes The Citizen’s Charl Bosch.

item.title: New or used? A practical guide to second hand farm equipment
item.description: Second hand farm machinery can deliver excellent value, if you know what to look for. Western Cape equipment broker Debbie Smit gave Lindi Botha practical advice to help farmers decide when to buy new, when pre-owned is the smarter choice, and how to avoid the costly pitfalls that often catch buyers off-guard.

item.title: Unpacking what sets the Agrico G3 centre pivot apart
item.description: Agrico’s G3 centre pivot irrigation system is designed to adapt to the challenges of modern farming and isn’t just another ordinary water application system.

item.title: Why variable speed drives make sense in modern irrigation
item.description: Variable speed drives are transforming modern irrigation by shifting control from valves to pump speed. Instead of running motors at full capacity and throttling flow, the drives adjust motor speed to match real-time crop water demand, reducing energy use, electrical stress and water hammer.

item.title: Africa’s specialty coffee scene: from everyday brew to artisan craft
item.description: Roland Urwin, café owner and coffee researcher, spoke to Octavia Avesca Spandiel about how South Africa’s evolving specialty coffee culture mirrors global trends, prioritising craftsmanship, origin, and quality-driven consumer experiences.
